 Game Coverage: Watch Listen Live Stats UNT Looks to Build on Strong Opening Week with Matchups Against Santa Clara, South Alabama
 11/10/2026 1:54:00 PM | Men's Basketball
 Live Stats vs. Santa Clara Live Stats vs. South Alabama ESPN+ vs. Santa Clara ESPN+ vs. South Alabama The Varsity Network Share: Share: DENTON, TX – Entering the week 2-0, North Texas men's basketball has two more opportunities to notch wins over teams that reached the postseason last year when reigning NCAA Tournament Team Santa Clara visits The Super Pit on Wednesday at 7 p.m. followed by NIT participant South Alabama on Saturday at 5 p.m.
Wednesday's meeting with Santa Clara (3-0) marks the first time the Broncos and Mean Green will play on UNT's home court through five previous matchups. The team looks to avenge a close loss suffered on a neutral court last season that was decided by three points. In that game, senior Cole Franklin had been a strong presence on the court – producing eight rebounds and six steals.
Back in the present, junior Je'Shawn Stevenson has gotten off to a start expected of the conference Preseason Player of the Year, leading the team with 22.5 points per game after exploding for his career best 30 in the win over McNeese. As the focal point of the offense, the junior has expanded his game to get his teammates involved, averaging five assists per game in the early going. When calling his own number, Stevenson has been one of the nation's best and most efficient, ranking 33rd in the country in total makes and 40th in points per game.
Shooting 54.6% from the floor, he ranks sixth in the conference but has taken ten more shots than the next closest student-athlete ranked ahead of him in field goal percentage.
Should UNT defeat Santa Clara, it will be the first win over a California program since 2022 (Fresno State).
Saturday, South Alabama (1-1) will be playing its third game of the week when it comes to The Super Pit. Despite trailing in the overall series 14-9, recent trends have skewed heavily in UNT's favor. Since 2010, North Texas is 5-1 against the Jaguars and 3-0 in Denton.
Another reprisal from last season, UNT defeated USA by a single point in Mobile, in large part due to the efforts of Stevenson – who scored 22 points.
Beyond Stevenson's accomplishments this season, sophomore Ousmane Ndour has emerged as a force on the boards, especially at the offensive end. The sophomore enters the week ranked tenth in the country in offensive rebounding with a 5.0 per game average. He has been reliable scoring as well, contributing 7.5 points per game.  
The Mean Green defense has been stout, taming McNeese's offense last week to 67 points after it had scored 99 on opening day against American Conference contemporary UAB. Entering the week, both UNT's scoring and field goal percentage defense rank top-40 in the nation.
Fans wishing to follow along remotely will have the option of tuning in via ESPN+ on streaming both games or the Varsity Network for a radio broadcast on both games.
